meta.title: Source document manifest
meta.note: Every source document referenced in data/history.json (reports and audits), data/counties-cob.json and data/national.json. sha256 is computed over the exact PDF bytes downloaded from the Parliament of Kenya library (DSpace bitstream). A hash is recorded only when the file was downloaded and its MD5 matched the checksum the library publishes; otherwise sha256 is null and access says why. retrieved is the date the figures were read; hashed_on is the date the file was downloaded and hashed. Documents from sites that publish no checksum (parliament.go.ke, siaya.go.ke) are not hashed even when downloaded: sha256 is null and access says so. The World Bank API (data/national.json) is a live service, not a file: its responses are not hashed; each indicator records the API's last_updated date. Additions of 27 Nov 2026 (research sweep): county documents from the KIPPRA repository and the County Assemblies Forum, and the Parliamentary Budget Office report, are hashed as received (those publishers state no checksum; checksum_note says so); Parliament library files are hashed after their published MD5 matched.
meta.method: Item resolved through https://libraryir.parliament.go.ke/server/api (items, bundles, ORIGINAL bitstreams); file fetched with curl -L from the bitstream content URL; MD5 compared with the library checkSum; SHA-256 computed locally.

not_listed.reason: A snapshot of a live API response (World Bank Projects API, JSON), not a cited document file; the hash of the snapshot is kept with the source in data/siaya-programmes.json, and a new read gives different bytes.

A snapshot of a live API response (d-portal IATI search, JSON and XML), not a cited document file; the hash is kept with the source in data/siaya-programmes.json, and a new read gives different bytes.

A saved copy of a live web page (KEMRI PBIDS home page, HTML), not a document file; the source library records the page as discovered (no copy kept in the repository), so the hash stays with the source in data/siaya-programmes.json.

meta.not_listed_note: Hashes cited by values but deliberately not listed as manifest documents, each with the reason (census 28 Nov 2026). scripts/census.js reads this list.
